That depends on what you're after, so here's the general picture. A solid leg day usually has a squat or leg press pattern, a hinge like a Romanian deadlift, something single-leg like split squats or lunges, and a bit of hamstring and calf work. Most people do well with 3 to 4 sets per movement, in the 6 to 12 rep range, leaving a couple of reps in the tank.

If you'd like me to put an actual session together, say "give me a leg day" and tell me how long you have and what equipment you're working with. The app will build it for you to confirm.
